content.value_statement: Backlink audits are hard when authority, toxicity, and competitor gaps are spread across exports. This skill turns backlink data into quality scores, risks, opportunities, and outreach-ready next steps.
actual_capabilities: Creates backlink profile overviews with referring domains, authority metrics, link velocity, and follow status mix.
Scores link quality using authority, relevance, traffic, placement, anchor text, and follow status.
Flags toxic-link patterns such as PBNs, spam sites, paid links, link farms, and risky anchor text.
Compares competitor backlink profiles to find shared referring domains and link gap opportunities.
Builds outreach plans for broken links, resource pages, guest posts, unlinked mentions, and digital PR.
Tracks new links, lost links, recovery actions, and reporting KPIs for ongoing SEO monitoring.
limitations: Requires backlink exports or connected SEO tools; it does not collect link data by itself.
Authority metrics are third-party estimates and should include source names and collection dates.
Disavow recommendations need human review before upload to Google Search Console.
Outreach templates require personalization and compliance with applicable email laws.

use_cases.title: Audit a backlink profile
use_cases.description: Review link quality, toxic-link risk, anchor text balance, and priority fixes for an owned domain.

use_cases.title: Find link building prospects
use_cases.description: Compare competitors to identify resource pages, unlinked mentions, broken links, and guest post opportunities.

use_cases.title: Prioritize outreach work
use_cases.description: Turn backlink exports into a ranked action plan with effort, impact, and outreach angles.

prompt_templates.title: Audit my backlink profile
prompt_templates.prompt: Analyze the backlink profile for [domain]. I will provide a backlink export with source domain, target page, anchor text, follow status, and authority metrics. Summarize profile health, link quality, anchor distribution, and the top actions I should take.

prompt_templates.title: Review toxic backlink risk
prompt_templates.prompt: Check these backlinks for toxic-link risk. Classify each risky link by issue type, confidence, recommended action, and whether it should be removed, monitored, or considered for disavow after review.

prompt_templates.title: Compare competitor link gaps
prompt_templates.prompt: Compare my domain, [domain], against these competitors: [competitors]. Find domains linking to competitors but not us, explain why each site might link, and rank opportunities by authority, relevance, effort, and likely impact.

prompt_templates.title: Create a quarterly link strategy
prompt_templates.prompt: Use my backlink export, competitor exports, link velocity history, and content inventory to build a 90-day link strategy. Include toxic-link cleanup, link recovery, prospect segments, outreach angles, KPIs, and weekly priorities.

output_examples.input: A backlink export for a SaaS domain with source domains, authority scores, anchors, target pages, and follow status.
output: Profile health score: 74 out of 100, with strong branded anchors and moderate link velocity.
Primary risk: 18 low-authority exact-match links from unrelated blogs should be reviewed.
Best opportunity: resource pages that link to two competitors but not the audited domain.

output_examples.input: Competitor backlink exports for three CRM companies and an owned domain.
output: Top gap: review directories and comparison sites that link to all three competitors.
Second priority: broken links on industry resource pages with relevant replacement content.
Outreach angle: position the owned guide as an updated resource for CRM selection workflows.

output_examples.input: A toxic-link review request with suspected spam domains and paid links.
output: Critical links: suspected PBN and paid links without nofollow should be reviewed first.
Recommended workflow: request removal, document responses, then prepare a conservative disavow file.
Do not disavow low-authority domains only because they have weak authority metrics.

best_practices: Provide complete backlink exports with source domain, target URL, anchor text, follow status, and collection date.
Review toxic-link recommendations manually before requesting removal or uploading a disavow file.
Compare against direct competitors so opportunity scores reflect the real search landscape.
anti_patterns: Do not judge link quality by DA or DR alone without relevance and placement context.
Do not disavow links only because they are nofollow or low authority.
Do not send outreach templates without personalization, consent review, and deliverability checks.

faq.question: Does this skill fetch backlink data automatically?
faq.answer: No. It needs backlink exports or connected SEO tools supplied by the user or environment.

faq.question: Can it create a Google disavow file?
faq.answer: It can suggest entries and formatting, but a human should review every disavow decision before upload.

faq.question: Which tools can provide useful input data?
faq.answer: Any backlink export with referring domains, anchors, target pages, authority metrics, and follow status can work.

faq.question: Can it analyze competitors?
faq.answer: Yes. It compares competitor referring domains, link velocity, content attracting links, and shared link opportunities.

faq.question: Does it guarantee ranking improvements?
faq.answer: No. It provides SEO analysis and priorities, but search performance depends on many external factors.

faq.question: Is outreach content included?
faq.answer: Yes. It includes templates and strategy guidance for broken links, resource pages, guest posts, mentions, and PR.
